terra.problem: The dough joke has no clear connection to the point being stated before the parable's characters appear.
The comparison to buttering a batch of cookies does not clearly match the idea of praising the judge.
“All day long and all night long” turns “day and night” into an uninterrupted cry, which the text does not specify.
“No day gets skipped” adds a precise frequency that the text does not give.
Papa says he has his own group chat. Things outside his bakery, such as group chats, come up as things people do, not as his own.
The explanation says the parable isn't over yet, but Jesus goes on to tell a different parable.
Saying he has already viewed others with contempt before breakfast makes contempt a recurring habit, contrary to his positive, godly character.
The text does not say the Pharisee physically points at the tax collector, and it says the tax collector stood at a distance, not nearby.
